solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Distinct part played with ease

indicators.note: a piece that is played is performed in a new way, so these letters are freely rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An actor handles a distinct role without any effort.
explanation.definitionFit: Separate as an adjective means apart or individual, a close synonym of distinct.

clue.text: Thus repeatedly less than brilliant

parts.note: so means thus or in this way
the previous word is given again

explanation.surface: Something keeps turning out disappointing in the same way.
explanation.definitionFit: So-so means mediocre or merely middling, which is less than brilliant.

clue.text: Bird priest trapped in soft container

indicators.note: something trapped in a place is held inside it, so one piece goes within another

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for soft
Eli is the priest of the Old Testament who raised Samuel
a can is a metal container

explanation.surface: A priest's pet bird has got stuck inside a flimsy box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soft' and 'container' together make the outer word, so the priest sits between them; Eli is the Old Testament priest crosswords use constantly.
explanation.definitionFit: The pelican is a large water bird known for its throat pouch.

clue.text: Recalling English person in club, in clique?

indicators.note: the second in places the preceding pieces inside the following word

parts.note: a ring is a close group or clique
E is the abbreviation for English
a club member belongs to it

explanation.surface: An English club member reminiscing, perhaps within an exclusive set.
explanation.definitionFit: Remembering is bringing back to mind, which is what recalling means.

clue.text: Piece of headgear that is seen outside work

indicators.note: a word seen outside another surrounds it, so it wraps around the following piece

parts.note: taken as written
op is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: A hat that is worn when outside the office.
explanation.definitionFit: A top hat is a tall formal hat, so a piece of headgear.

clue.text: Vehicle parking? Grumble

parts.note: a car is a road vehicle
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: A driver who cannot find a parking spot complains about it.
explanation.definitionFit: To carp is to complain persistently about trivial things, so it matches the verb grumble.

clue.text: View of one of Britain's invaders?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a point of view or slant
second meaning: a member of the Germanic tribe who settled in England

explanation.walkthrough: The Angles, with the Saxons and Jutes, invaded Britain in the fifth century and gave England its name.
explanation.definitionFit: An angle is a perspective on an issue, and an Angle was one of the tribe that invaded Britain.

clue.text: Request to render song is delightful

parts.note: a plea is an earnest request
to sing is to perform a song

explanation.surface: Being asked to perform a song is a lovely thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Pleasing means giving pleasure, which is close in sense to delightful.

clue.text: Males revolting in US city

indicators.note: rebels who are revolting overturn the established order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Men are rising up in rebellion somewhere in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Salem is a city in Massachusetts, famous for its witch trials, and also the state capital of Oregon.

clue.text: Greek character, villain in canoe

parts.note: pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
a rogue is a dishonest scoundrel

explanation.surface: A Greek baddie is paddling a canoe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a container signal, but it only links the wordplay to the definition at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A pirogue is a long narrow dugout boat, a kind of canoe used in the Caribbean and Louisiana.

clue.text: Members of family embracing good upper-class rules

indicators.note: something embracing another holds it within its arms, so it surrounds the following pieces

parts.note: relations are relatives
G is the abbreviation for good
U denotes upper-class usage

explanation.surface: Relatives hug a well-bred person who follows the rules.
explanation.definitionFit: Regulations are official rules, so the plural noun matches.

clue.text: Activists — people in tents drinking a gin excitedly

indicators.note: something that is drinking takes another thing inside itself, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: campers sleep in tents

indicators.note: doing something excitedly means in an agitated, jumbled way, so these letters are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: Protesters at a camp are having a lively drink of gin.
explanation.definitionFit: Campaigners work actively for a cause, which is what activists are.

clue.text: Most pure Charles facing ordeal?

parts.note: Chas is a short form of Charles
a test is a trial or ordeal

explanation.surface: Charles faces a gruelling trial of his virtue.
explanation.definitionFit: Chastest is the superlative of chaste, meaning purest in morals.

clue.text: Something in wardrobe husband found with annoyance

parts.note: H is the standard abbreviation for husband
anger is strong annoyance

explanation.surface: A wife finds something in the wardrobe that irritates her husband.
explanation.definitionFit: A coat hanger is the item clothes hang on inside a wardrobe.

clue.text: Food component — gorge to get energy needed initially

parts.note: to glut is to gorge or overfill
E is the symbol for energy in physics

indicators.note: initially points to the beginning, so only the opening letter of the word is used

parts.note: the first letter of needed

explanation.surface: Advice that you must stuff yourself to get the energy you need.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gorge' is a verb here, not a ravine.
explanation.definitionFit: Gluten is the protein found in wheat and other grains, a constituent of many foods.

clue.text: Agreed to be restricted about everything

indicators.note: about means around, so the word before it surrounds the word after

parts.note: tied means bound or restricted
all means everything

explanation.surface: Someone agreed to be limited in what they could do.
explanation.definitionFit: Two accounts that tallied matched or corresponded, a sense of agreed.

clue.text: Top person offers newspaper article

definitions.meaning: first meaning: one who heads a group
second meaning: the editorial piece giving a paper's opinion

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a leader is also the main editorial column of a newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: A leader heads an organisation, and the leading article is the editorial voicing the paper's view.

clue.text: Emotional part of hospital involved in various ailments

indicators.note: being involved in something means being placed inside it, so one piece goes within the other
various suggests differing forms or arrangements, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged
ENT is the ear, nose and throat department

explanation.surface: A hospital department dealing with all sorts of illnesses.
explanation.definitionFit: Sentimental means swayed by tender feelings, so it is a synonym of emotional.

clue.text: Emperor, say, being entertained by rising star

indicators.note: a guest being entertained is taken in by a host, so this piece goes inside the other
in a down clue, rising means read from bottom to top, so the word runs backwards

parts.note: the sun is our star
e.g. means for example, as does say

explanation.surface: An emperor is hosted by a rising celebrity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' is not a homophone signal here; it stands for e.g.
explanation.definitionFit: Negus was the title of the Emperor of Ethiopia, borne by Haile Selassie.

clue.text: Explosive Irish fellow expecting to succeed?

parts.note: HE is high explosive
Ir is an abbreviation for Irish

explanation.surface: A volatile Irishman confident of success.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Explosive' looks like an anagram signal but supplies letters itself.
explanation.definitionFit: An heir is the person in line to inherit, so he expects to succeed to a title or estate.

clue.text: Needing to make arrangements for the match?

definitions.text: Needing to make arrangements for the match?

parts.words: Needing to make arrangements for the match?
parts.note: surface reading: a sports team organising a fixture
setter's reading: the match is a marriage, which a betrothed couple must plan

explanation.walkthrough: The sporting sense of match misleads; a match is also a wedding, and a couple promised to marry have one to arrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A couple who are betrothed have agreed to marry and so must plan their wedding.

clue.text: Delayed in a slippery situation?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: put aside or postponed for now
second meaning: literally standing on frozen water

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is meant literally, though it reads like a figure of speech for a precarious position.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for a plan suspended or postponed matches delayed, and frozen ground is literally slippery.

clue.text: Time to demand a job

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time
to ask is to request or demand

explanation.surface: It is high time to insist on being given work.
explanation.definitionFit: A task is a piece of work to be done, so it is a synonym of a job.

clue.text: One of the 11 less sophisticated, going round South Africa

indicators.note: going round something means surrounding it, so one piece wraps the other

parts.note: cruder means more primitive or less refined
SA is the abbreviation for South Africa

explanation.surface: A rather unrefined activist travels around South Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: The 11 is 11-across, CAMPAIGNERS; the answer is one of them.
explanation.definitionFit: A crusader is someone who campaigns vigorously for a cause, so is one of the campaigners.
